definition: to let fresh air into something
description: At an old wooden chalet in a sunny mountain village, a smiling young woman in a white shirt leans out over an upstairs balcony rail and shakes a big white duvet out into the fresh air, flapping it up and down and laughing. Pillows hang on the wall beside her, a striped rug hangs on the rail next to red geraniums, and below, an older woman in a striped cardigan arranges pillows while a cat sits beside her. A church tower with an onion dome and snowy peaks rise in the background.

en.question: What is the young woman doing?

de.answer: Sie schüttelt eine Bettdecke über dem Balkon aus.
de.question: Was macht die junge Frau?

es.answer: Está sacudiendo un edredón por el balcón.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la joven?

fr.answer: Elle secoue une couette au-dessus du balcon.
fr.question: Que fait la jeune femme ?
